title: MPP charge with the stripe method (Shared Payment Token)
summary: The challenge names the seller profile and accepted payment method types. The client creates a Shared Payment Token scoped to that seller and sends its id; the server creates and confirms a PaymentIntent and returns the PaymentIntent id as the receipt reference.

steps.label: 402 with method="stripe"
steps.detail: request carries amount, currency, methodDetails.networkId (the seller Business Network Profile) and methodDetails.paymentMethodTypes.

steps.label: Create a Shared Payment Token
steps.detail: The client collects a payment method, which may prompt 3DS or a biometric check, and creates an SPT with usage limits (currency, maximum amount, expiry) scoped to the seller profile.

steps.label: Retry with credential payload {spt}
steps.detail: The payload carries the token id.

payload.content:
# decoded credential payload (Illustrative example, spec version draft-stripe-charge-00)
{ "spt": "spt_1QabcDEF...", "externalId": "order_42" }

steps.label: Create PaymentIntent (confirm true)
steps.detail: After checking the challenge id and expiry, the server creates a PaymentIntent with confirm true, the token as shared_payment_granted_token and metadata.challenge_id. The idempotency key combines the challenge id and the SPT. Connect fields come from server configuration, never from the challenge.

failures.condition: Stripe answers with Idempotent-Replayed for a new challenge
failures.outcome: Treat as replay; mppx before 0.4.11 missed this (CVE-2026-34210).

steps.label: PaymentIntent status
steps.detail: Only status succeeded produces a receipt.

steps.label: 200 with Payment-Receipt
steps.detail: The receipt reference is the PaymentIntent id (pi_...). The payment shows up in the seller Stripe Dashboard like any other.

payload.content:
# decoded receipt (Illustrative example, spec version draft-stripe-charge-00)
{ "status": "success", "method": "stripe", "timestamp": "2026-10-11T12:00:02Z", "reference": "pi_3Qxyz..." }
